msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya. The manuscript breaks off in the 19th story.

lg.l: || kathayiantvaṃā hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvānadbhutāṃs tathā ||

lokaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryapṛchadyudhi
ṣṭiraḥ ||
yo rakṣet prāṇināṃ brahman_ bhayārtaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||

tasya puṇye aphaḷaṃ yat syās ta
n me brūhi tapodhana ||
|| ekataḥ kratavā sarve samāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ ||

ekato bhayabhītasya
prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ ||
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||

iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiber auśīnara
sya tu ||
vartamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śibaṃ nṛpaṃ ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gniḥ bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ ||
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapota śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī mahīpāḷaṃ vililye bhayavihvaḷaḥ ||

tataḥ
śanair samāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ ||
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā ||
|| āhus tvaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ sarvabrahmavidodvijāḥ ||
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi ||

bhāavān_ kṛ
kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ ||
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇaṃm asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet ||

apakāre pareṣv evam upakāra
paro janaḥ ||
apakārapare pi tvaṃm upakāravase yathā ||
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃm apāpo py asi sarvadā ||

doṣānveṣaṇa
rakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ||
sadaiva vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||

mahāṃs tvaṃ dharmabudhyāstvaṃ nādharmaṃ ka
tum arhasi ||
saṃtrastarūpaḥ prāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||

matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛ
ghrurayāṃ khagaḥ ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayārthinaḥ ||
katham asmadvidhas tyāgaṃ kuryāt sadbhir vigarhitaṃ ||
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajecharaṇāgataṃ ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

śāstreṣu niṣkṛti
r dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||
śaraṇāgatahaṃtas tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit ||

yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayaṃ trastāḥs trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ ||

janmamṛtyujarārogaṃ nityaṃ
saṃsārasāgare ||
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃti mṛtyos chāsyaṃti jaṃtavaḥ ||

yannimitto bhavechokas trāso vā krodha e
va vā ||
āvāso vā yato mūḷam ekāṃtam api saṃtyajet ||

yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanapriyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ pri
yaṃ ||
saṃrakṣyase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣya jīvitaṃ ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ ||

ya
d atra yuktam anyaṃ te vaktuṃ śyenāśu tad vada ||
āhaāreṇa ca bhūtāni prabhavaṃti nareśvara ||

āhāreṇa
vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ ||
śakyaṃte duḥkare marge āhāreṇa ca jīvituṃ ||

na tv āhāravihīnasya śakyaṃ varddharta
yituṃ kvacit ||
bhakṣoād vilopitasyaite mama prāṇā viśāṃpate ||
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti puaṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ ||
mṛte mayi ca sarvaṃ me putradāra vinaśyati ||
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotas tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi ||

dharmaṃ yo bādhate
dharmeo na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapaḥ ||
avirodhi tu yo dharmān sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||

tasmād virodhadharmasya viciṃtya
gurulāghavaṃ ||
yato bhūyas tato rājan_ kuru dharmavinirṇayaṃ ||

nāto bhūyaḥ paro dharmaḥ
kaścid anyo sti khecara ||
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃm abhayaṃ yaḥ prayachati ||

varam ekasya satvasya pradattaṃ jīvi
tābhayaṃ ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||

hemadhenudharādā
naṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvajīvadayāparaḥ ||

mahatām api yajñānāṃ kāḷena kṣīyate phaḷaṃ
||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas tatyaṃ tīrthaṃ vedaśṛtaṃ tathā ||

sarvāṇy abhayadānasya
kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ ||

abhayaṃ yas tu bhūtebhyaṃs tayor abhayado
dhikaḥ ||
parityaje hi rājeṃdraṃ śarīraṃ vāpi dustaraṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ maṃke dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ ||

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ
kiṃcit purā janmani janmani ||
bhave trātā bhayoārtānāṃ mārtināśāyadehināṃ ||

na cāhaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ
na punarbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ ||
yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vāṇim aham ekām udāhare ||

sa
tyenānena bhagavā prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhaṃ na ca vāyaṃ vihaṃgamaṃ ||

yad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāraṃ martyad eva
dadāmy ahaṃ ||
yādṛśo vihato smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ ||

yan me tvaṃ sṛjya nāhāraiḥ kā
ryam atyaparair mama ||
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ matvāt kadaḷīstaṃbham āruha ||
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacit_ varte vihaṃgama ||
śāstrair ava tathokto yaṃ dharmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ ||

sa
rvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā ||
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikevia viśiṣyate ||

vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhū
tahite ratāḥ ||
dayādarśitapathānāṃ brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te ||
gacchatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrata svapato pi vā ||

yan na
bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni schāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavat parirakṣaṃti
te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣayet ||

sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃm iti prāhur manī
ṣiṇaḥ ||
rājyaṃ śibīnāṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvija ||
yadi kāmayase cānyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ ||
yadi rājan kapote tu sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||
tatvāṃ kapotas tulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||

etad ahaṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icha
si ||
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś carād vadati vā na vā ||
mama tu priyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt ||

adhruveṇa śarī
reṇa pratīkṣaṇavināśinā ||
dhruvo yo nārjayed dharmaḥ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||

yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayu
jyate ||
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ nareśva
ra ||
tasmāt prayacha sadṛśaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtaṃ ||

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhā
ṣase ||
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syād datvā tava vihaṃgama ||

evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa
pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭas tu tathā māṃsaṃ kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||
tyaktvātma sukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatva yathaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bhavaṃti
paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate ||

punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni
rājan pradāt sa pārthivaḥ ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||

tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ
svayaṃ ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvasatvasukhe ratāḥ ||
nopekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api ||

atha ta
smin samārūḍhe tuḷām auśīnare nṛpe ||
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha ||

tatas tasyāḥ svamāṃ matvā rmardhadharmarāja
schitiṃ parāṃ ||
śakrasvarūpam āschāya vākyam etad abhāṣata ||
śakro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyahanaḥ ||

jijñāsamā
nau tvāṃ rājan_ imaṃ yajñam upāgatau ||
naitat pūrve nṛpāś cakruḥ na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||

mahākāruṇikenaiva yat kṛtaṃ du
ṣkṛtaṃ tvayā ||
parārthaṃ tyajataḥ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tava ||
prāṇasaṃtrāṇalubdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ ||

parā
rthaiḥ kāṃtikadhiyā svāśrayātyaṃtaniṣṭurā ||
tvayy eva kevaḷaṃ rājan_ kurute karuṇāpadaṃ ||

svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛ
ḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣāya baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||

tathā sarvātmanā cāpi deheṣu prathi
taṃ tvayā ||
yathā caivātmasaṃpannā vāsanāpi na roṣitaḥ ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||

akṛtvā
sadṛśai sparddhoā tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||

sa yāti paramaṃ schā
naṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ ||

svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anye
ṣu kā kathā ||
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevaḷātmodaraṃbharāḥ ||
sa punar jīvitaślāghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ hi jīviati ||

kiṃ cātra ci
traṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||
na hi svadehaśāṃtyarthaṃ jāyaṃte ca dhanodgamāḥ ||

paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ
sadā ||
sa padaṃ tad avāpnoti parādṛṣṭi ca yat paraṃ ||
paropakārairadhirkaḥr kadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gamaspṛhā ||

jagaddhitāya jā
yaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pārthiva ||

eṣā te śāśvatī kīrtir lokā
n anugamiṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pāḷayitvā tu medinīṃ ||
sarvalokān atikramyabrahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgni jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ ||
rājā tu kratum aśnā tu mumude vavadat tadā ||

ya idaṃ śruṇuyān ni
tyaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ ||
sa nidhāyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ ||

viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhṛvaṃ dhṛvaṃ
yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durlabhaṃ ||
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau ||

body.p:
|| iti śrī
itihāsasamuccaye śiber ākhyānaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ ||
